worked_example.problem: A farmer’s soil is sandy and dries out quickly. Give two ways to improve it.
steps: Add compost or manure: humus helps sandy soil hold water and gives nutrients.
Mulch the soil with dry grass to keep the water in.
worked_example.answer: Add compost or manure, and mulch.

cards.idea: A fertile soil is rich in humus and nutrients, holds water but drains, has air and many living things.
example: Many earthworms are a sign of a healthy soil.

cards.idea: Compost, manure and green manure add humus and nutrients to the soil.
example: Kitchen peelings can be turned into compost.

cards.idea: Mulching keeps soil moist; bush burning destroys humus.
example: Dry grass on the soil shades it from the sun.

wrong.text: Water stays on top for days.
